movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.description: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.description: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II, exploring the deep moral dilemma and geopolitical upheaval of the dawn of the nuclear era.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
movies.description: Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence. When the heroes clash on how to handle a new threat, Miles must redefine what it means to be a hero.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.description: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft, along with a team of researchers, to find a new planet for humans.

movies.title: Gladiator II
movies.description: Years after witnessing the death of the revered hero Maximus at the hands of his uncle, Lucius must enter the Colosseum after his home is conquered by the tyrannical Emperors who now lead Rome with an iron fist.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.description: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary Deadpool behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

movies.title: Spider-Man : Brand New Day
movies.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day follows an adult Peter Parker living in total anonymity, protecting a New York that no longer remembers him while coping with the isolation and strain of being a full‑time hero. The film offers a grounded, emotionally rich story, mixing gritty action with personal stakes, unpredictable powers, and standout performances from Tom Holland and Jon Bernthal. Praised as one of the best Spider-Man films yet, it's a must‑watch for fans.

movies.title: Bahubali - The Beginning (RE-RELEASE)
movies.description: Baahubali: The Beginning is a 2015 Indian epic action film co-written and directed by S. S. Rajamouli, and produced by Shobu Yarlagadda and Prasad Devineni under Arka Media Works. Produced in the Telugu film industry, the film was shot in both Telugu and Tamil languages. It features Prabhas in a dual role alongside Rana Daggubati, Anushka, Tamannaah Bhatia, Ramya Krishnan, Sathyaraj, and Nassar.
